decision: Approve preparation of one exact first-round literal certificate, its sole wrong-word control, and a mandatory actual CompressRaw consumer through the fixed six-remaining-round context. This is source specification approval only; no implementation or native execution by this reviewer, and no permission to rerun the failed full-state phase.
actualDiagnosisBoundary: Actual state-negative source check succeeded; verify returned4/LLS8002 with configured300000, observed300022ms and outer369333ms. No intended wrong-c0 semantic rejection or accepted proof. Six cgroup counters remained zero. Emitted theorem was a single full-state rfl without certificate application. The proposed smaller cut changes the proof obligation; no precise timing bottleneck or sharing pathology has been established.

productionConnection.input: Use the actual first buffered bytes0..63 from accepted S64, not incoming bytes64..127. blake3BeforeByte compresses the old full buffer before appending byte64. Preserve exact IV chain, counter0, blockLength64, flags1 (start only).
productionConnection.message: M0 = R4.Blake3.blake3BlockWords(B0), B0 exact typed Nat cons-list0..63 ending typed nil. Actual block-word fields s0..s15 use offsets0,4,...,60; each little-endian word is byte[offset]+256*byte[offset+1]+65536*byte[offset+2]+16777216*byte[offset+3]. Keep the actual BlockWords expression in certificate and consumer statements unless a separately checked equality explicitly connects a replacement.
productionConnection.initial: S0 = R4.Blake3Core.b3CoreInitialRaw(R4.Blake3Core.b3CoreIV(),0,64,1). InitialRaw returns B3CoreState: first8 fields from IV; s8..s11 first4 IV constants; s12=counter mod2^32; s13=counter div2^32; s14=64; s15=1.
productionConnection.round: Actual RoundRaw(current,message)=Diagonals(Columns(current,message),message). Both parameters and result are B3CoreState, not B3CoreCV.
productionConnection.recursion: Rounds(0,s,m)=s; Rounds(Nat.succ(n),s,m)=Rounds(n,RoundRaw(s,m),Permute(m)). CompressRaw(chain,message,counter,blockLength,flags)=FeedForward(Rounds(7,InitialRaw(chain,counter,blockLength,flags),message),chain). Thus exactly one production recursion step exposes RoundRaw(S0,M0) and Permute(M0) under six remaining rounds. Do not use Permute(R1), six permutations or an unpermuted message.
productionConnection.output: FeedForward returns all16 B3CoreState words: first8 xor state halves, last8 xor upper half with chain. This proposed consumer is a full16word compression-result equality with residual computation, not final literal CV or final digest.

actionableInterface.names: Suggested isolated modules Blake3FirstRound, Blake3FirstRoundContext, Blake3FirstRoundLift and Blake3FirstRoundConsumer. These are authoring names, not existing registered product capabilities.
actionableInterface.certificate: first_round_full_state : b3CoreRoundRaw(S0,M0) = R1literal. Parameters[], axioms[], proof {kind:reflexivity}. R1literal must contain exactly sixteen s0..s15 fields, each decimal Nat less than4294967296; use an actual record {kind:record,type:{module:R4.Blake3Core,name:B3CoreState},fields:[{field:s0,value:{kind:nat,value:<decimal>}},...]} rather than inventing a B3CoreState constructor or passing an eight-word CV.
actionableInterface.literalTrust: Derive all16 words from pinned production AST as untrusted authoring data. A future reviewed bounded derivation may evaluate the exact RoundRaw definition; retain recipe/input/output hashes. No host calculation, external BLAKE3 library, trusted CV, axiom or nonempty theorem axioms may replace actual kernel proof. This reviewer did not derive or approve numeric R1 values.
actionableInterface.negative: Copy the positive certificate exactly and change only R1.s0 to (R1.s0+1) modulo4294967296. This always differs within the32bit domain, including wraparound. Statement inputs, remaining15 fields, theorem name, proof, imports/config/limits identical apart from necessary fixture module metadata. Require independent AST delta check. A timeout/blank failure/import/type failure is not the intended named reflexivity rejection.
actionableInterface.context: Define G(item:B3CoreState):B3CoreState = b3CoreFeedForward(b3CoreRounds(6,item,b3CorePermute(M0)),b3CoreIV()). Define Goal(count:Nat):Prop by match count: zero -> RoundRaw(S0,M0)=R1; succ prior -> G(RoundRaw(S0,M0))=G(R1). Succ body does not recursively apply G prior times.
actionableInterface.lift: round_lift(count):Goal(count), axioms[]. Reuse the actually accepted proof AST scheme: induction count; zero Apply qualified first_round_full_state with arguments[]/type_arguments[]; succ binders prior,ih then Cases prior; zero and succ branches Congruence, with earlier bound in succ. No Rewrite, Have, Transitivity, Simplify, native_decide or new proof constructor. Cases is on prior Nat, not a fabricated state/equality constructor.
actionableInterface.consumer: first_round_compress_consumer : b3CoreCompressRaw(b3CoreIV(),M0,0,64,1) = b3CoreFeedForward(b3CoreRounds(6,R1literal,b3CorePermute(M0)),b3CoreIV()). Parameters[],axioms[]; Apply qualified round_lift with Nat1. Actual CompressRaw must be the LHS AST, and exact production argument order must be retained. G(RoundRaw(...))=G(R1) alone is insufficient delivery.
actionableInterface.visibility: Each wrapper directly imports every external referenced module including R4.Blake3Core and R4.Blake3 when BlockWords occurs. Current-module references omit module keys and resolve earlier local declarations; never self-qualified or module:null. Include exact builtin Nat glossary and canonical semantic JSON used by accepted sources. Compute actual import closure from new frozen sources; do not invent expected counts in this specification.

boundedAcceptance.stages: Prepare exact negative and positive round certificate sources plus context/lift/actual consumer in one bounded source packet. Separate source/CODE/security review, exact invocation/resource review and parent phase selection precede any native run. First intended wrong-word negative must receive actual diagnostic/resource audit before positive certificate selection; actual consumer success is mandatory after accepted certificate. Helper acceptance alone leaves this experiment incomplete.
boundedAcceptance.positiveEvidence: For each selected positive closure audit exact actual source/lock/tool identities, empty-axiom declarations, real successful verification artifact and kernel replays/process results. Consumer must actually Apply the certificate through lift, with exact actual CompressRaw statement and residual6round RHS. No final-value equality or speedup inferred from that partial compression theorem.
boundedAcceptance.stop: One selected phase at a time, unchanged configured300000ms and current resource contract. Stop on timeout, OOM/nonzero counters, source/type failure, unexpected negative success, capture/retention/identity/postguard failure. No automatic retry, restart, limit raise, positive full-state retry or speculative7round/32block expansion.
boundedAcceptance.risk: One-round rfl may itself time out. Actual consumer matching may still reduce expensive round/state arguments or remaining rounds. Existing Nat/Cases/Congruence syntax and the mathematical definitional connection support this proposal; neither establishes native feasibility or performance.
boundedAcceptance.remaining: Even if certificate and actual consumer pass, exact literal S128 with all7 fields, complete compression/FirstEight, outer input/state validation and feed behavior, original2048tree consumer, finalization/ROOT/digest encoding and published digest remain mandatory. Preserve failed second-state source and receipts unchanged. No accepted-count increase, OOM repair or product completion.
